headline: Bitcoin is sitting just under $80,000 the day before the Fed decision, Ripple has won final approval for a US national trust bank, and crypto earnings week starts with Galaxy and Robinhood today.

market.asOf: Read from CoinMarketCap's bitcoin, ether and solana pages around 07:57 UTC Tue 27 Oct (14:57 Bangkok). Live prices are at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: 43 out of 100 on CoinMarketCap's CMC Crypto Fear & Greed Index; 50 (Neutral) on alternative.me's index

stories.title: Bitcoin waits just under $80,000 for Wednesday's Fed decision
stories.summary: Bitcoin slipped below $80,000 again on Tuesday as traders wait for the Fed decision on Wednesday, where a hold is widely expected. Data on Monday's US bitcoin fund flows is mixed, ether funds saw money leave, and a large batch of bitcoin options expires on Friday.
points: Bitcoin was $79,769, down 0.1% over 24 hours, at 6:00am on 27 Oct, per Analytics Insight citing CoinGecko.

US spot bitcoin ETFs (funds that hold bitcoin for stock-market investors) took in a net $110M on Monday 26 Oct, all of it into BlackRock's IBIT, per SoSoValue data reported by PANews. An earlier Lookonchain tally reported by Phemex showed a $169.47M outflow instead.
US spot ether ETFs lost a net $88.58M on Monday, per SoSoValue data reported by PANews.
94 of 100 economists in a Reuters poll expect the Fed to hold rates at 3.75-4.00%, per Newsquawk.
Bitcoin options worth about $12.2B (notional) expire on Deribit on Friday 30 Oct, with 'max pain' at $79,000, per CryptoTicker. Max pain is not a price target.

stories.title: Ripple wins final approval for a US national trust bank
stories.summary: The OCC, the US regulator for national banks, gave Ripple final approval for Ripple National Trust Bank late on Monday. The bank will hold the reserves behind Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin and offer custody to institutions. A trust charter does not let it take deposits or make loans. The news lands on the first day of Ripple's Swell conference in New York.
points: Ripple applied in July 2025 and received conditional approval on 12 Dec 2025, per The Block.
RLUSD, Ripple's dollar stablecoin, is worth about $2.5B in total, per The Block.
Circle got final OCC approval in July 2026; Coinbase, Crypto.com and World Liberty Financial hold conditional approvals, per The Block.
RLUSD launched in December 2024 and BNY holds most of its reserves, per CoinDesk.
Swell runs 27-29 Oct at The Shed in New York, per Digital Today.

stories.title: Crypto earnings week: Galaxy and Robinhood today, analysts trim targets
stories.summary: Galaxy reports before the US market opens today and Robinhood after it closes; Coinbase and Strategy follow on Thursday. Ahead of the results, Bernstein cut its Coinbase target and Mizuho cut its Circle target. Strategy bought no bitcoin last week.
points: Galaxy reports before the Nasdaq opens on Tue 27 Oct, with an investor call at 8:30am ET (19:30 Bangkok), per its announcement.
Robinhood reports after the close on Tue 27 Oct with a call at 5:00pm ET (04:00 Wed Bangkok), per its announcement.
Bernstein cut its Coinbase price target to $250 from $330 and its 2026 Coinbase revenue forecast by about 32% to $5.5B, while keeping an Outperform rating, per The Block.
Mizuho cut its Circle price target to $43 from $45; Circle shares closed Monday at $79.84, down 7%, per The Block.
Strategy bought no bitcoin from 19 to 25 Oct, still holds 848,517 BTC, and bought back about $204.9M of its STRC preferred shares instead, per The Block.

briefs.title: CoinDCX warns of phishing after its $16M loss
briefs.summary: The Indian exchange warned on 27 Oct about fake emails and alerts impersonating it after the 21 Oct drain of 15.99M USDT; Tether froze 2.21M USDT. CoinDCX says it never asks for seed phrases or one-time codes, per CoinGabbar.

briefs.title: Korean exchanges flag Initia after $2.7M exploit
briefs.summary: Bithumb and Upbit put trading warnings on INIT after an attacker exploited a bug on Initia and bridged out about $2.7M, per The Crypto Times.

briefs.title: NBA signs CFTC prediction-market agreement
briefs.summary: The NBA is the third league after MLB and the NHL to sign with the CFTC, and named Kalshi and Polymarket as preferred exchanges, per The Block.

briefs.title: BlackRock and SBI explore a yen stablecoin link
briefs.summary: BlackRock signed a memorandum with SBI and Startale to connect tokenized money market funds with SBI's yen stablecoin JPYSC, per The Block.

briefs.title: Zcash co-founder proposes ending grants funding
briefs.summary: Sean Bowe proposed ending the automatic 8% share of new ZEC that goes to Zcash Community Grants, citing a treasury worth about $125M, per CoinDesk.

Reports after the US close. Consensus revenue about $1.43B and EPS about $0.55 (KuCoin).

Rate is 2.25%; a hike to 2.50% is the consensus (InvestingLive), with markets pricing about 80% (Newsquawk). Strategy's special shareholder meeting on daily preferred dividends is at 10:00am ET (21:00 Bangkok).
Range 3.75-4.00% after a 25bp hike in September; a hold is expected (94 of 100 economists in a Reuters poll, per Newsquawk). Chair Warsh's press conference 2:30pm ET (01:30 Bangkok).

calendar.note: GDP consensus 3.0% (Newsquawk) or 3.2% (InvestingLive), prior 2.2%. PCE 3.6% a year expected, prior 3.4%; core 3.1%, prior 3.0% (Newsquawk). The ECB also decides Thursday; a hold at 2.50% is expected (InvestingLive).
Both report after the US close; Coinbase revenue estimate about $1.20B (PrimeXBT). Token unlocks the same day: FF ~$19.5M and CARDS ~$19.1M, per the unlock data on this page.

At 08:00 UTC. About $12.2B notional with max pain at $79,000 (CryptoTicker). Max pain is not a price target. The Bank of Japan also decides Fri 30 Oct; a hold at 1.25% is expected (Newsquawk, InvestingLive).
Prior 0.9%, consensus 0.8% (Trading Economics). Fed speakers Daly (12:00pm ET) and Musalem (12:30pm ET) also speak Friday (Kiplinger).
